data.exact_reserve_text: The net loss ratio for the financial year improved to 88.9% (2018: 104.2%) driven by reserve releases in older years of account due to better than expected claims experience. However, increased claims provisions on the 2019 year of account offset these releases, driven by catastrophe events (Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian) and other attritional losses related to wind, storm and hail.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6125 recorded a gross prior-year reserve release of approximately GBP 2.31m (about 9.17% of opening gross claims reserves). The release is attributed to favourable claims development in older years of account (better than expected claims experience). These releases were partly offset in 2019 by increased provisions on the 2019 underwriting year driven by natural catastrophe events (Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian) and other attritional wind/storm/hail losses. No quantification by individual prior underwriting year or by line of business is provided.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' (Gross column). Premium mix is from the Managing Agent's divisional summary (no statutory segmental table present) - 'mix from divisional summary'. Named catastrophe events are mentioned but not quantified against reserves. No specific prior underwriting years were explicitly identified in narrative as driving the prior-year movement.
